method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates the partially transparent connected-text image, an analysing-stripe backing and a second stripe with a different tint. The literal image/material/shader settings and insertion order are retained; the selected direct statements contain no game-service analysis or connection request. Provider and optional unresolved PostLoadFunc effects remain unknown. Exact child order: ConnectedText, AnalysingBacking, AnalysingBackingAdd. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.
